elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Section 9.1 requires compliance with Performance Standards or commercially reasonable performance and expressly imposes “no other or higher degree of care”; it does not provide a professional-and-workmanlike warranty.

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: Section 16.1(G) warrants that the software used to provide the Services will conform in all material respects to its documentation.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The software conformance warranty lasts only ninety days following delivery.
No Services warranty with a ninety-day duration is stated; Section 9.1 contains performance obligations but no ninety-day warranty period.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: Section 16.1(G) requires M&I to repair or replace non-conforming software as alternative remedies.
Section 16.1(G) permits a refund of fees paid for the affected Services.

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no warranty of compliance with applicable laws.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no malicious-code warranty for Services or Deliverables.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Section 16.1(G) warrants material software conformance to documentation for ninety days following delivery.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: Section 9.1 imposes performance obligations but states no Services warranty lasting at least thirty days.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: Section 16.1(G) expressly provides repair or replacement for breach of the software warranty.
Section 16.1(G) expressly provides a refund of fees paid for the affected Services.
